hereford_chapel_1.jpg.author: Baldyp
hereford_chapel_1.jpg.description: Built at the end of World War II to remember fellow Italians who had died at Hereford Camp in the time that it was in commission.

hereford_chapel_2.jpg.author: Baldyp
hereford_chapel_2.jpg.description: This Chapel was built by Italian prisoners of the POW camp in Hereford, Texas to memorialize their five friends who had died during their stay there at the camp.
